label: Present-receipt controls checked (inference)
rule: Explicit one-world interpretations over natural-number times with two individuals, checked by case analysis and linear arithmetic
meaning: The inertial history with past-tense receipt satisfies the onset reading and correlativity and falsifies the present-tense reading and 40a97664; with standing receipt it satisfies the present-tense and onset readings and falsifies correlativity and 40a97664; the sustaining history with no receipt satisfies 40a97664 and falsifies the present-tense reading; each premise of the onset derivation is needed in one interpretation; all premises and 40a97664 hold together in one interpretation.
